audience: Dutch small businesses and bookkeepers that keep their books and invoices in Silvasoft

useCases.title: List outstanding sales invoices
useCases.text: List sales invoices by date, or only the outstanding ones. Add the invoice lines to see the items on each invoice.

useCases.title: Check the price and stock of a product
useCases.text: Find a product by article number or EAN. Read its price, VAT and stock quantity.

useCases.title: Review sales orders and purchase invoices
useCases.text: List sales orders by order date or status. List purchase invoices by number or date.

useCases.title: Look up customers and suppliers
useCases.text: List customers and suppliers with their contact and address details. Filter, page and sort the list.

useCases.title: Add a new customer or supplier
useCases.text: Create a business customer or supplier. If one with the same e-mail, name or number exists, Silvasoft returns it and creates nothing.
